<section class="archive-section">

<div class="section-label">
03 · Why does this website even exist? :D
</div>

<div class="archive-list">

<div class="archive-intro">

<p>
 -That's the question I asked myself-. There had to be a reason, because building and maintaining it obviously eats up my time, and like everyone else's, my time is limited.So why bother sitting down and forcing myself to think this hard about it? Honestly, my reasons are selfish, I won't pretend otherwise.</p>
<p>But that selfishness is exactly why I try to hold whatever I publish to some minimum standard, so that someone who doesn't share my assumptions can still make sense of it. And sure, I won't pretend I'm not also interested in being easier to find, in having my work seen by potential recruiters or collaborators. But underneath all that, what I really want is to put into words how I think about the limits we all live with.</p>
<p>That's really all I've got to say. I hope you don't mind the more casual tone, and that you're patient enough to figure out what exactly I'm trying to get across here. One last thing: I'd love to hear what you think, because in a way, none of this means anything if nobody reads it. So drop me an email, my contact info's right here on the site.</p>
</div>
